messages.content: 將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？

function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure

The user might be asking about the pressure change due to heating. The tool provided is thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure. So we should use that. The function expects volume, initial_temperature, final_temperature, initial_pressure optional. We can assume initial_pressure default standard atmospheric pressure (101325 Pa). So we call the function with volume=2, initial_temperature=25, final_temperature=100. Then we get the result. Then we respond with the result. The user didn't specify units.
